title: Account
name: Name

nameSheet.title: Your name
nameSheet.hint: This is the name shown on your profile and in greetings.
nameSheet.saveFailedMessage: Please check your connection and try again.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.linkHint: Opens Telegram so you can tap Start in @gracechords_bot. Once linked, send the bot a song title and it sends the chord chart back.

unlinkAlert.title: Unlink Telegram?
unlinkAlert.message: The bot will stop sending you charts until you link again.

songStats.title: Song Stats
songStats.hint: Song Stats records the sets you run and the songs you open in GraceChords. Your stats are yours — no other GraceChords user can see them. Song counts across all users are added up anonymously to help decide what to build next.

offAlert.title: Turn off Song Stats?
offAlert.message: GraceChords will stop recording your sets and song opens, and stop counting the tools you use. History already recorded stays until you clear it. Turning Song Stats back on won’t bring back anything you’ve cleared.

clearAlert.title: Clear your Song Stats history?
clearAlert.message: This permanently deletes every set and song open recorded for your account. It can’t be undone.

songStats.cleared: Your Song Stats history was cleared.

logOutHint: Signs you out of GraceChords on this device.
deleteAccountHint: Permanently deletes your account and all of your data.
